bilder.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final transparent PNG sprite for an original children's 2D exploration game. Style: disciplined 16-bit pixel art, clearly visible square pixels, designed on a coarse 64x64 logical pixel grid and enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges. Limited 18-color palette: dark teal #254950 outlines, warm cream #fff4d9, forest #477c66, mint #83b89a, coral #df785d, honey #ecc365, lavender #a69ac8. Consistent gentle daylight from upper left, sparse hand-placed pixel highlights, restrained detail readable at 120px. Slightly top-down front view, parallel front walls, not isometric. Transparent alpha background, no environment or ground tile. No lettering, logos, watermarks, emojis, gradients, glow, blur, painterly texture, shiny 3D, micro-detail, or existing game characters. Square canvas, centered standalone building, entire roof and foundation visible. All house sprites share this exact frame: building spans roughly x=130..894, roof top at y=160, front-door bottom/foundation baseline at y=900, transparent padding on all sides. Wide simple silhouette. Door centered at x=512. A welcoming small coding workshop. Coral terracotta gabled roof, cream walls, deep teal outlines, mint windows, centered teal door. A tiny pixel monitor symbol above door and two simple window-box plants. Architecture must be clean, coherent and symmetrical.
